Exact fixed-direction cap-offset exclusion for VL12_DUAL_CANCEL21_G4.
Dependency: immutable parent result figure-0438 and exact cap patch [internal-source-reference].

Polar separator direction a=(3/5,-1,-1). Let h be the polar cap offset and t=1/h, so the dual physical body is K_t=conv(K_parent_centered union {t a}).
The full strict separator interval is
max_retained < h < min_packet,
where
max_retained=5377780345688294868040000/3290438764026334302719257,
min_packet=6104561850604438971752000/2717758194599235640710191.
Equivalently
t in (t0,t1) with
t0=2717758194599235640710191/6104561850604438971752000,
t1=3290438764026334302719257/5377780345688294868040000.
The old polar vertex side partition is constant on this whole interval, hence the clipped polar and dual physical incidence are constant: V22/E60/F40,C120.

Using the origin, which remains interior, as a tetrahedral anchor, the exact filled volume is affine in t and the first moment is quadratic. Therefore for an old vertex i and old neighbor j the strict-U edge derivative numerator
N_ij(t)=(x_i V(t)-M(t)) dot (x_j-x_i)
is quadratic, with V(t)>0. For each edge incident to old vertices 11 and 18, transform t=t0+(t1-t0)u, u in [0,1], and express N_ij in degree-2 Bernstein basis. The following triples are the exact Bernstein coefficients after multiplication by a positive common factor and division by their positive gcd. Every listed integer is strictly negative, so every N_ij(t)<0 throughout the closed interval. Thus vertices 11 and18 are simultaneously strict unstable for every strict cap offset h in the separator interval; U>=2 everywhere. Therefore this entire fixed separator-direction cap chart contains no strict110 body, independently of stable/mixed counts.
